react/jsx-no-constructed-context-values.why: WIRED 2026-08-12 as hosted/... behind the React Compiler gate. @typescript-eslint/naming-convention.why: tsgolint lists it unimplemented, but our options never query types -- hosted with stubbed parser services. The 6th finding is the quoted 'foo-bar' property: our options define no requiresQuotes entry, so it is checked like any other property. Both tools agree, which is what proves the stubbed compilerOptions.target is harmless

rulesdir/no-inline-useOnyx-selector.why: WIRED 2026-08-12 behind the same React Compiler gate; ungated it reports 238 findings across 186 files that ESLint's processor drops. Fixture opts out of memoization so it tests the rule, not the gate

no-new-object.why: WIRED 2026-08-11 under its post-rename name: ESLint deprecated no-new-object in 8.50 for no-object-constructor, and oxlint only implements the new one.
